service_tier.description: Codex service tier for the thread.

headers.description: Additional string-valued HTTP headers sent to the Agent Protocol server.

name.description: Unique asynchronous subagent identifier exposed to the main agent.

url.description: Optional Agent Protocol server URL; omit it to use the SDK's default endpoint.

condenser.description: OpenHands conversation history condenser. Use none to keep the full history.

api.description: The wire protocol Pi uses to talk to this model.

cost.description: Per-million-token pricing. All four rates are required and non-negative.
